up: List all distinct compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1255231. For each compound, provide the compound's ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum development phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Sort the results by the compound's ChEMBL ID in ascending order.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1255231' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC
